name: bld6_rank_cube_sub_self_defect
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) : A.rank + (A - 1).rank + (A + 1).rank = 2 * Fintype.card ι + (A * A * A - A).rank
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K), A.rank + (A - 1).rank + (A + 1).rank = 2 * Fintype.card ι + (A * A * A - A).rank
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld3_rank_tripotent_defect and Mathlib2.bld2_rank_add_rank_one_sub: the idempotent-defect identity bld2_rank_add_rank_one_sub applied to A and to -A gives rank(A*A - A) = rank A + rank(A - 1) - n and rank(A*A + A) = rank A + rank(A + 1) - n (ranks invariant under negation); substitute both into bld3_rank_tripotent_defect: rank(A*A+A) + rank(A*A-A) = rank A + rank(A^3 - A). Corollary: A^3 = A iff rank A + rank(A-1) + rank(A+1) = 2n.
